title: Accurate pie chart labeling for text alignment
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Created new pie chart and redid labels to more accurately show the parameter that is being changed for the demo.

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

The documentation page for pie charts lists text alignment as a changeable parameter but this was not reflected well in the demo.
author: JenningsWilliam

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
```suggestion
        title Offset labels close to border: Product X
```

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: This is a direct code suggestion providing a specific text change to a line in the file.
